#include "alx_pc/standalone/doom_game/_shared_"

function number doom_getWallTexturePixel(TexX:number, TexY:number) {
    local Tex = array(
        224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,
        224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,
        160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,
        160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,
        224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,
        224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,
        160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,
        160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,
        224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,
        224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,
        160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,
        160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,
        224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,
        224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,224,224,160,160,
        160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,
        160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96,160,160, 96, 96
    )
    
    local ClampedX = clamp(TexX, 0, 15)
    local ClampedY = clamp(TexY, 0, 15)
    local Addr = ClampedX + (ClampedY << 4) + 1
    
    return Tex[Addr, number]
}
